parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved steel rod attached to the sides of the bucket, allowing it to be carried easily.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a grip for lifting and carrying the bucket, transferring the load from the bucket body to the user's hand.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to swing freely for carrying or resting against the bucket.

parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is a circular plastic cover that fits snugly on top of the bucket to seal its contents.
parts.Functional_description: It prevents spillage, contamination, and evaporation of the bucket’s contents by providing a tight seal.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or placed on the bucket by lifting or pressing down, typically with a snap-fit or twist-lock mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical portion of the bucket that holds liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for storing and transporting materials, providing structural integrity and volume capacity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, though it can be tilted or lifted when pouring or emptying contents.
